section.title: Code.Scripts.Weapons.BulletMath Class Reference

para.para: Utility class for bullet math operations.

listitem.para: Convert an angle from the interval J = [0,2*Pi] to an angle in I = [-Pi,Pi] where 0 in J is mapped to 0 in I. This is needed since the godot angle function uses angles in I.
static float RestrictHomingAngle (float angle, float maxAngleRadians)
Ensure that the angle does not exceed the interval [-maxAngleRadians, maxAngleRadians]. If it is not inside this interval, the closed interval border will be returned.
